description: EnvCell records where Rust holtburger-dat and Chorizite DRW disagree on a non-failing topology field. Allowlist sentinel budget is 5; current count is 1.

entries.rootCause: acclient.c::CEnvCell::IsVisible treats the array as orderless; the two ports happen to read the same bytes in different orders due to internal dictionary iteration order. Not a parser bug; not a runtime regression.
